summary: Frontend-only Greek-translation QA pass on KNDP single-page site. All 4 navbar links (Αρχική, Υπηρεσίες, Έργα, Επικοινωνία) scroll to their sections. Hero word-mask animation and ChatPhone (typed Greek biz names) render cleanly. Problems/Services/HowItWorks/Portfolio/FAQ/Footer all render Greek without clipping. Portfolio carousel arrows/dots work. FAQ accordion expands/collapses. Contact form submits successfully to POST /api/contact (verified via curl round-trip: POST->200 with Greek payload, GET->200 returns persisted record). No English leftovers detected via regex scan of visible text. No backslash/unescaped-quote artifacts. No horizontal overflow on desktop (1920) or mobile (390) — only intentional rfm-marquee width. Zero JS console errors and zero pageerrors during full page load and interactions.

minor.issue: Request body sends 'services' (array) from the Greek form, but backend stores/returns only a singular 'service' field which is null in the persisted document. Data is saved (name/email/company/message) but the selected service chip value is lost. Not a translation regression — pre-existing schema mismatch.

action_items: (Optional/pre-existing) Align Contact form payload with backend: either backend accepts services:[...] or frontend sends service:'Website'. Currently the service selection is silently dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactSection sends `services` array but backend Pydantic model expects singular `service` — selected chip is not persisted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Greek sections, nav, carousel, FAQ, form, mobile)

test_credentials: N/A - no auth on this site
seed_data_creation: Created a couple of TEST_ prefixed contact messages via form + curl for round-trip verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav uses data-testids nav-link-{home|services|portfolio|contact}. Contact form testids: contact-{name|email|company|message}-input, service-chip-{lowercased-english-value} (e.g. service-chip-website, NOT the Greek label), contact-submit-button. GET /api/contact returns 403 to urllib default UA but 200 to curl/browser — use requests/curl. Backend POST accepts payload but has schema mismatch: expects `service` (singular) not `services` array.
